source: NTA JEE Main information brochure 2026, JEE Advanced 2026 information brochure

JEE_Main.purpose: Gateway for NITs, IIITs, GFTIs. Also mandatory for JEE Advanced eligibility.

eligibility.age_limit: No age limit as of 2017 onwards. Removed. No upper age barrier.
eligibility.year_of_passing_12th: First attempt in Class 12 must be in the year of JEE or the previous year only. Two-year window.
eligibility.number_of_attempts: Maximum 3 consecutive years of JEE Main
eligibility.subject_requirement_btech: Physics and Mathematics mandatory. Plus any one of: Chemistry, Biology, Biotechnology, Technical Vocational subject
eligibility.class12_marks: 75% aggregate for General/OBC/EWS. 65% for SC/ST/PwD. OR top 20 percentile of board.

exam_pattern.sessions: 2 sessions per year - January and April

question_types.MCQ: 20 questions per subject (4 marks each, -1 negative marking)
question_types.Numerical: 10 questions per subject (attempt any 5), 4 marks each, NO negative marking

scoring.NTA_score: Score out of 300 in Paper 1. Maximum 300.
scoring.percentile_calculation: Based on all candidates in THAT session
scoring.normalization: When multiple sessions held, normalization applied across sessions to make scores comparable
scoring.best_of_two: Better of January and April NTA score used for final rank. Both attempts considered.
scoring.CRL_rank: All India Rank based on final normalized NTA score
scoring.cutoff_for_advanced: Top 2.5 lakh unique candidates in JEE Main become eligible for JEE Advanced

what_score_cutoff_for_NITs_typically.note: These are broad estimates. Actual cutoffs vary by year, institute, category, quota. Always check actual JoSAA data.

JEE_Advanced.conducted_by: One of the IITs (rotates each year)

eligibility.JEE_Main_cutoff: Must be in top 2,50,000 in JEE Main (Paper 1). Category-wise cutoff applies.

age_limit.general_obc_ews: Must be born on or after October 1, 1999 (for 2026 Advanced)
age_limit.sc_st_pwd: Must be born on or after October 1, 1994 (5 year relaxation)

eligibility.year_of_12th: Should have appeared for Class 12 for the FIRST TIME in 2023 or 2026 (two-year window)
eligibility.no_previous_IIT_admission: Must NOT have previously taken admission in any IIT program (even if left after one day)
eligibility.class12_percentage: Same as JEE Main: 75% for General/OBC/EWS, 65% for SC/ST/PwD
eligibility.criterion_B4: Should not have accepted IIT admission by reporting to IIT in any previous year

exam_pattern.marking_scheme: Varies by question type. Partial marking for some. Negative marking for some.
exam_pattern.total_marks: 360 (varies slightly year to year - always check official brochure)
exam_pattern.minimum_in_each_subject: Must score minimum cutoff marks in each subject individually
exam_pattern.minimum_aggregate: Must score minimum aggregate cutoff to qualify

AAT.for: B.Arch at IITs (IIT Roorkee, IIT Kharagpur, IIT Varanasi BHU)
AAT.exam_type: Drawing and architecture aptitude. Freehand drawing, 3D visualization, geometric drawing.

result.category_wise_cutoffs: Minimum marks in each paper + minimum aggregate for each category
result.zone_ranks: IITs divided into 7 zones. Zone rank used for tiebreaking in some IITs.
result.preparation_for_JoSAA: JEE Advanced rank required to apply for IITs in JoSAA

registration.when: After JEE Main result, in May

what_ranks_get_which_IITs.note: These are rough estimates. Exact cutoffs from JoSAA data files should be used.

JEE_ecosystem_overview.JEE_Advanced_eligibility: Top 2.5L from JEE Main announced in May.
